Builddrone 0.4.4 fixes a PowerShell/AppVeyor false failure after successful
pipeline stages. Child-process notices such as pip's upgrade warning were
written to stderr; PowerShell treated that as `NativeCommandError` even when
the command exited 0.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/

---

## Bug fixes

### Child-process stderr on PowerShell CI

`Runner.run()` now merges child stderr into stdout. Informational output from
tools such as pip and twine no longer lands on PowerShell's error stream.

Non-zero exit codes still fail the stage. Success and failure continue to be
determined by the process exit code, not by whether a tool wrote to stderr.

### pip upgrade notices during `python.install`

`python.install` now passes `--disable-pip-version-check` to
`python -m pip install`. This suppresses pip's "A new release of pip is
available" notice, which was the stderr line AppVeyor reported as
`Command executed with exception` after a successful PyPI upload.
